spans.text: For VBM analysis we used the Statistical Parametric Mapping program (SPM 2) developed in the Wellcome Institute (London, UK).

description.value: VBM preprocessing included spatial normalization, segmentation into tissue compartments, and smoothing.

spans.text: VBM methods ( Ashburner and Friston, 2000 ) involved spatially normalizing high-resolution images of all the subjects in the study into the same stereotactic space, and then individual subjects' images were registered to the same template image by minimizing the residual sum of squared differences between them.
For VBM analysis we used the Statistical Parametric Mapping program (SPM 2) developed in the Wellcome Institute (London, UK).

First, the standard space for spatial normalization was the standard space of Talairach and Tournoux (1988) . Second, normalized images were segmented into gray matter, white matter, cerebrospinal fluid, and skull scalp compartments through an automated process. Third, the spatially normalized segments of the gray and white matter were smoothed with a 12-mm full-width, half-maximum isotropic Gaussian kernel to accommodate individual variability.
the spatially normalized segments of the gray and white matter were smoothed with a 12-mm full-width, half-maximum isotropic Gaussian kernel
